name: ifc_open_model
doc: Open an IFC2x3 or IFC4 artefact and return schema, units, and a stable model handle.

name: ifc_entities_by_type
doc: Retrieve IFC entities by class with GlobalId and source-model provenance.

name: ifc_property_values
doc: Read property-set values for selected entities while retaining value types and units.

name: ifc_quantity_values
doc: Read base quantities and convert explicit IFC measure types without dropping source units.

name: ifc_type_assignments
doc: Resolve occurrence-to-type assignments and inherited type properties.

name: ifc_material_layers
doc: Return material-layer composition, thickness, and association provenance.

name: ifc_classification_refs
doc: Resolve classification and external-reference assignments for applicability filtering.

name: ifc_unit_context
doc: Read project unit assignments and conversion-based units from the IFC context.

name: ifc_element_summary
doc: Serialise selected entity attributes, properties, quantities, and identifiers for evidence export.

name: spatial_containment_graph
doc: Build project-site-building-storey-space-element containment edges.

name: spatial_adjacency_graph
doc: Compute space and opening adjacency with geometry-derived contact evidence.

name: spatial_egress_paths
doc: Trace candidate egress paths through spaces, doors, stairs, and exits.

name: spatial_clear_width
doc: Measure geometric clear width at an opening after frame and obstruction deduction.

name: spatial_travel_distance
doc: Measure traversable path distance in a declared coordinate frame and unit.

name: spatial_clearance_envelope
doc: Test unobstructed manoeuvring or accessibility clearance envelopes.

name: spatial_opening_geometry
doc: Reconstruct opening geometry and local coordinate frame from placements and representations.

name: rel_contained_in_storey
doc: Join selected elements to containing spaces and building storeys.

name: rel_space_boundaries
doc: Resolve physical and virtual space-boundary relationships.

name: rel_connectivity
doc: Resolve element connectivity and path continuity across openings and circulation elements.

name: rel_group_membership
doc: Resolve zones, systems, and group memberships used by provision applicability.

name: rel_document_associations
doc: Resolve document and classification associations with source identifiers.

name: rule_predicate_eval
doc: Evaluate an inferred threshold predicate over a typed quantity table.

name: validate_ifc_schema
doc: Validate required IFC classes, attributes, property types, cardinality, and identifiers.

name: validate_unit_ranges
doc: Canonicalise units and flag quantities outside physically plausible ranges.

name: validate_evidence_chain
doc: Check that report claims resolve to committed IFC observations and verifier verdicts.

name: bim_evidence_export
doc: Export typed evidence, rejected candidates, and verifier verdicts as an audit record.

name: bim_report_render
doc: Render a compliance report mechanically from committed evidence and verdict slots.

name: cq_new_document
doc: Create an empty CadQuery workplane and parametric feature document.

name: cq_sketch_profile
doc: Create a dimensioned and fully constrained 2D sketch profile.

name: cq_extrude
doc: Extrude a closed profile by a bound depth with join, cut, or new-body semantics.

name: cq_revolve
doc: Revolve a closed profile around an explicit axis and angular extent.

name: cq_hole
doc: Create dimensioned through, blind, countersunk, or counterbored holes.

name: cq_pattern
doc: Apply linear, rectangular, or polar feature patterns with parametric spacing.

name: cq_fillet
doc: Apply radius-constrained fillets to explicitly selected edges.

name: cq_chamfer
doc: Apply equal-distance or two-distance chamfers to selected edges.

name: cq_boolean
doc: Fuse, cut, or intersect solids and preserve operation provenance.

name: cq_shell
doc: Create a constant-thickness shell after removing selected faces.

name: cq_transform
doc: Apply explicit placement, rotation, mirroring, or assembly transforms.

name: solid_kernel_validate
doc: Independently check B-rep validity, watertightness, self-intersection, and feature constraints.

name: bbox_mass_validate
doc: Measure bounding box and mass properties against the inferred two-percent tolerances.

name: cad_step_export
doc: Export a verified solid to STEP with feature, geometry, and file hashes.

name: cad_evidence_export
doc: Export construction history, constraint checks, rejected candidates, and audit hashes.
